parsed.summary: Wacky Wheels Lexington is down 2027-03-24 to 2027-03-25. 6 production orders were moved, with 6 rescheduled after the restart and 0 transferred to other plants because same-plant slots ran out. 25 dealers were notified once each for 56 customer orders and 15 loaners were assigned.
